verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly has a dedicated first-party 'Webhooks' documentation page under its infrastructure docs, which shows that subscribing to events via webhooks is a documented product capability. The pack gives only the page title, not its content, so the depth of the feature cannot be verified. Missing for 10: details on which event types can be subscribed to, filtering or scoping of subscriptions, payload signing and verification, delivery and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
